```sql
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
       count(*)           AS order_count,
       max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.id
   AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
 WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
 GROUP BY c.id
HAVING max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
   AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De query scant `orders` nu één keer, zonder MATERIALIZED-CTE en zonder sortering voor DISTINCT ON. Alleen orders van klanten van de opgegeven tenant worden meegenomen, via de join met `customers`. `max(created_at)` is gelijk aan de eerste rij van `DISTINCT ON … created_at DESC`, en de filter op de laatste order staat in `HAVING`. Het resultaat is daardoor identiek.
